name: Gap Calculator
description: Select two objects in the editor and get the gap between them plus the minimum and recommended TPS to get through it.

ticks.name: Safety ticks (Recommended)
ticks.description: When Recommended is on, the gap/TPS leaves room for this many physics ticks inside the gap. Recommended off uses 1 tick (the bare minimum).

hitbox-big.name: Wave hitbox: Big (units)
hitbox-big.description: Wave solid hitbox used by the Big button. Calibrated from the Mini value; adjust if you know better.

hitbox-mini.name: Wave hitbox: Mini (units)
hitbox-mini.description: Wave solid hitbox used by the Mini button.

hitbox-smallest.name: Wave hitbox: Smallest (units)
hitbox-smallest.description: Wave solid hitbox used by the Smallest button (a guess, adjust to taste).

custom-speed.name: Custom speed (units/sec)
custom-speed.description: Overrides the speed buttons when greater than 0.

button-offset-x.name: Button offset X
button-offset-x.description: Nudges the Gap button horizontally from its default spot beside the color picker.

button-offset-y.name: Button offset Y
button-offset-y.description: Nudges the Gap button vertically from its default spot.
